blind.description: A rustic wooden fence segment composed of two upright rectangular timber posts and three horizontal wooden rails attached across them, fastened by dark hexagonal metal bolts on both sides. The geometry is clean, solid, and stylized with softly beveled edges and defined wood grain texturing. All surfaces are continuous and structurally sound, with no floating or distorted elements, resting directly on the bottoms of the two vertical posts without an extra base.
blind.from_above: A straight horizontal line formed by the top rail, punctuated near each end by the rectangular tops of the two vertical posts with protruding bolt heads on the sides, and rail ends extending slightly past the posts.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (less than half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 4 feet wide.
